name: Connors RSI(2) Mean Reversion
description: Larry Connors' RSI(2) mean-reversion strategy (Short Term Trading Strategies That Work, 2008). Buys quality TSX stocks with extreme short-term oversold readings (2-period RSI < 10) within confirmed uptrends (price above 200 SMA). Backtested 1993-2024: 75-88% win rate, ~1% avg gain/trade, profit factor 2.5, Sharpe ~1.4. Exit when close crosses above 5-day SMA or RSI(2) > 70. Hold 3-5 days.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX mid-to-large cap stocks in confirmed uptrends trading above 200-day moving average that have sold off sharply in the last 2-3 days short-term oversold RSI extremely low but long-term trend intact quality fundamentals Piotroski 5+ low debt strong earnings not broken trend just short-term pullback within uptrend
ta_focus: CONNORS RSI(2) STRATEGY — EXACT RULES: (1) TREND FILTER: Daily close MUST be above the 200-day simple moving average — if below, do NOT buy, the uptrend is broken. (2) ENTRY SIGNAL: The 2-period RSI must close below 10 (standard) or below 5 (aggressive). The lower the RSI(2) reading the better — cumulative RSI(2) over 3 consecutive days summing below 15 is the highest-probability setup (79% win rate). (3) CONFIRMATION: Look for price touching or piercing the lower Bollinger Band with a reversal candle (hammer, doji, engulfing), volume spike on the sell-off day showing capitulation. (4) EXIT RULE: Sell when the daily close crosses ABOVE the 5-day simple moving average, OR when RSI(2) crosses above 70. Whichever comes first. (5) TIME STOP: If neither exit triggers within 10 trading days, exit at next open. (6) STOP-LOSS: Use a regime stop — exit immediately if the daily close drops below the 200-day SMA (trend broken). For individual stocks also consider 2x ATR(14) hard stop below entry. (7) POSITION SIZING: Max 4% of portfolio per position, spread across 3-5 concurrent setups. KEY CHART PATTERNS TO CONFIRM: EMA 50 should still be above EMA 200 (golden cross intact), MACD histogram should be reducing on the downside (seller exhaustion), Supertrend should still be green or about to flip green on the daily.
trading_style: Connors RSI(2) mean-reversion swing trader, 3-5 day holds, buy extreme short-term oversold in uptrend

name: TSX Early Momentum
description: Catches TSX stocks just beginning their move — transitioning from base-building to early breakout. Screens for low ADX rising, first EMA stack forming, volume picking up from quiet base. Avoids exhausted moves already up 20%+. Win rate target: 55-60% on 2-5 day holds.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks early momentum building from consolidation base EMA stack starting to form increasing volume from quiet base recent analyst upgrades improving earnings estimates mid-to-large cap breaking out of range not already extended beginning of uptrend formation
ta_focus: EMA 9 crossing above EMA 21 with EMA 50 starting to curl up, ADX 15-30 showing trend is forming not already strong, RSI 50-65 bullish but not overbought, MACD histogram just turning positive from near zero, Supertrend flipping green, volume expanding from low base 1.5x+ average, price breaking above recent consolidation range, ATR expanding from compression
trading_style: Day to swing trader, 2-5 day holds

name: TSX Swing Breakout
description: Golden cross and Bollinger Band squeeze setups on TSX. Targets confirmed EMA 50/200 golden cross with volume confirmation, or BB squeeze breakouts with ADX trending up. Tight constraint style with higher volume floor. Win rate target: 60%+ on 1-3 week holds.
screening_prompt: TSX stocks recent EMA 50 crossing above EMA 200 golden cross pattern or Bollinger Band squeeze breakout confirmed strong uptrend improving fundamentals analyst upgrades mid-to-large cap quality businesses entering new uptrend phase volume confirming breakout
ta_focus: EMA 50 above EMA 200 golden cross confirmed or Bollinger Band width at 20-day minimum squeeze with breakout, price above both major EMAs, ADX > 25 confirming trend strength and rising, RSI 50-70 bullish zone, MACD above zero line with positive histogram expanding, Bollinger Bands expanding on breakout, Supertrend green, volume 1.5x+ average on breakout day confirming institutional participation
trading_style: Swing trader, 1-3 week holds, trend following

name: TSX Breakdown Short
description: Dedicated bearish strategy for TSX stocks breaking below key support. Screens for death cross (EMA 50 below 200), declining fundamentals, analyst downgrades, sector weakness. Smaller position sizing and higher R:R requirement for short trades. Win rate target: 50-55% on 3-7 day holds.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks breaking down below major support levels earnings miss guidance cuts analyst downgrades sector weakness death cross EMA 50 below 200 deteriorating fundamentals increasing short interest declining revenue growth insider selling high debt levels breaking below 52-week lows
ta_focus: Death cross EMA 50 below EMA 200, RSI below 40 and falling with no bullish divergence, MACD negative histogram expanding below zero, Supertrend red confirmed, ADX > 25 confirming strong downtrend, Williams %R staying above -20 showing persistent weakness, volume above average on down days confirming distribution, price making lower lows and lower highs, ATR expanding on breakdowns indicating acceleration
trading_style: Short swing trader, 3-7 day holds targeting breakdown continuation

name: Opening Range Breakout (30-min ORB)
description: 30-minute Opening Range Breakout strategy backed by academic research (Holmberg et al. 2013, Tsai et al. 2019) and a 12-year 6,142-day study on ES/NQ. Long-only bias (equities have +8-10% structural long advantage). 30-min ORB continuation rate: 64.6% overall, 75% for longs. Targets liquid TSX large-caps with confirmed catalysts and wide opening ranges.
screening_prompt: Canadian TSX stocks in play today breaking news earnings releases analyst upgrades sector catalysts liquid large-cap mid-cap high relative volume gap-up candidates with wide opening range active institutional participation confirmed price movement at open
ta_focus: 30-MINUTE OPENING RANGE BREAKOUT (ORB) — EXACT RULES from Holmberg/Tsai academic research + 6,142-day ES/NQ study: (1) OPENING RANGE: Identify the high and low of the first 30 minutes of trading (9:30-10:00 ET). This range captures the auction between overnight order flow and opening institutional orders. (2) LONG ENTRY: Price closes above the ORB High on a 5-minute candle AFTER 10:00 ET. Require the breakout candle volume to exceed the average volume of opening range candles (confirms genuine demand, not noise). (3) LONG BIAS ONLY: Research shows equities have a persistent structural long advantage — long continuation rate is 75% vs 65% for shorts. Only take long breakouts. (4) STOP-LOSS: Place stop at the midpoint of the opening range (tighter risk) or at the ORB Low (full range stop). Calculate R = entry - stop distance. (5) PROFIT TARGET: 1.0x to 1.5x the opening range size added to the breakout level. So if ORB range is $1.50, target is $1.50-$2.25 above ORB High. (6) TRAILING STOP: Once price reaches 0.5x extension (half the target), move stop to breakeven. (7) HARD CLOSE: Close ALL positions by 15:30 ET — avoid closing auction volatility. (8) CONFIRMATION FILTERS: VWAP — price should be above VWAP when breaking out (institutional flow confirming). Supertrend green on 15m chart. EMA 9 > EMA 21 on 15m (micro-trend aligned). RSI 50-65 (momentum but not overbought). ADX > 20 (directional, not chop). (9) BEST CONDITIONS: Wide ORBs outperform narrow ones (counterintuitive). Gap-up days with catalyst. High relative volume (2x+ average). (10) AVOID: Narrow range openings in low-vol sessions, inside days, no-catalyst drift.
trading_style: Opening Range Breakout intraday trader, 30 min to 5 hour holds, long-only bias

name: Crypto Swing
description: Swing trade crypto assets with strong momentum and on-chain metrics. Full EMA 9/21/50/200 stack with Supertrend and Bollinger Bands for AI chart reading. 3-month momentum filter added to avoid dead assets.
screening_prompt: cryptocurrencies strong momentum growing on-chain activity active addresses TVL growth developer activity protocol upgrades social buzz top 100 market cap EMA golden cross forming
ta_focus: EMA 50/200 golden cross or bullish stack, Supertrend green on daily, RSI 50-70 momentum zone, MACD histogram positive and expanding, Bollinger Bands widening on breakout, volume above 20-day average on up days, ATR expanding indicating trend acceleration

name: Crypto Intraday Scalp
description: Short-term crypto scalps on 15-minute charts with VWAP and Supertrend for direction, Williams %R for entry timing. Targets top-50 crypto with deep liquidity and confirmed intraday momentum.
screening_prompt: cryptocurrencies trending today high 24-hour volume breaking news token unlocks exchange listings viral social activity top 50 market cap deep liquidity major exchanges intraday momentum confirmed
ta_focus: VWAP holds on 15m chart with Supertrend green, Williams %R oversold bounce below -75 for long entries, RSI 45-65 momentum continuation zone, EMA 9 > 21 bullish micro-stack, MACD positive histogram on 15m, volume surge 2x+ on entry candle, ATR-based stops
trading_style: Crypto intraday scalper, 15 min to 2 hour holds
